# OpenCatz AI (Robinhood Chain Edition)

> OpenCatz AI is an autonomous, open-source Agentic AI crypto intelligence system built exclusively for Robinhood Chain (EVM L2, Chain ID #4663, Native ETH), deploying 5 Specialist AI Scouts governed by a 3-Layer Collaborative Consensus Protocol (≥ 80% Confidence Gate) and the 9-Lives Automated Risk Engine.

## Project Summary
- Name: OpenCatz AI (Robinhood Chain Edition)
- Version: 1.0.0
- License: MIT
- Runtime: Node.js (>= 22.12), TypeScript
- Target Network: Robinhood Chain (EVM L2 #4663)
- Primary DEX Engine: Uniswap V3 (Robinhood Chain)
- Repository: https://github.com/dizcorvus/opencatz-ai-robinhood-chain
- Web Portal: https://opencatz.xyz/robinhood-chain
- Documentation: https://opencatz.xyz/docs

## 5 Specialist AI Scouts (Robinhood Chain)
1. Robinhood Meme Scout (#call-meme-robinhood):
   - Scope: Robinhood Chain EVM DEX tokens (GMGN + GoPlus Security)
2. Robinhood LP Yield Scout (#call-lp-robinhood):
   - Scope: Concentrated Liquidity velocity via Uniswap V3 & Krystal Cloud
3. Robinhood NFT Scout (#call-nft-robinhood):
   - Scope: OpenSea Robinhood Chain NFT floor surges & mint momentum
4. Alpha & Sentiment Scout (#call-alpha-robinhood):
   - Scope: Robinhood Chain smart CT alpha & social sentiment signals
5. Hyperliquid ETH Whale Scout (#call-whale-eth):
   - Scope: Institutional ETH perps positioning & spot order flow

## Consensus & Risk Safeguards
- 3-Layer Swarm Consensus: Quant & Liquidity (40%), Catalysts & Sentiment (30%), Security Audit (30%) with >= 80% Confidence Gate.
- 9-Lives Risk Guard: Stop-Loss (-20%), Tiered Take-Profit (2x / 3x), Dynamic Trailing Stops, Universal Multi-Key Pool.

## Key CLI Commands
- `opencatz onboard`: Interactive setup wizard (.env & keys)
- `opencatz terminal`: Standalone Terminal TUI Command Center
- `opencatz run`: Development mode (tsx watch)
- `opencatz deploy`: 24/7 background process daemon (PM2)
- `opencatz test`: Automated Vitest test suite
- `opencatz doctor`: Health check, API key audit & RPC connectivity
- `opencatz update`: Automated Git pull, rebuild, and PM2 hot restart

## Discord Slash Commands
